searchText: Why has ropsten beacon explorer stopped updating? Looks like etherscan is fine Looks like only this Ropsten-explorer is stopped/syncing: https://ropsten.beaconcha.in The backup one seems ok: https://beaconchain.ropsten.ethdevops.io ah, weird. Well it's a good idea I think to have the public-facing beaconchain to be up to date 😅 has anyone from The Graph reached out about the issues on Ropsten testnets? they still are having indexing problems with their subgraph
